stderr:
Google Search Console Data Extractor (gscdump v7.8.5)

USAGE gscdump bing|init|dump|query|sites|sitemaps|sync|store|inspect|indexing|entities|analyze|report|auth|login|logout|status|config|profile|doctor|mcp|skill|papercut

COMMANDS

      bing    Authenticate Bing, list sites, dump data, and read Indexing Evidence                             
      init    Set up gscdump authentication                                                                    
      dump    Export the local Store, inspections, sitemaps, and Bing data to a directory                      
     query    Run a search analytics query (Store or hosted record; --live calls Google)                       
     sites    List GSC sites; manage properties (add/delete) and verify ownership                              
  sitemaps    Manage sitemaps                                                                                  
      sync    Sync GSC data, sitemaps, and URL Inspection results to the local Store                           
     store    Manage the local DuckDB/Parquet store                                                            
   inspect    Read Google URL Inspection results and save them to the Store                                    
  indexing    Notify Google about URL changes (Indexing API); read and refresh hosted URL Inspection results   
  entities    Read saved URL inspections and save Google Indexing API metadata                                 
   analyze    Run an Analyzer over Search Console rows                                                         
    report    Run a Report to find traffic changes, SEO opportunities, and risks                               
      auth    Manage authentication                                                                            
     login    Set up Local mode (service account or OAuth client) or Hosted mode (--mode hosted)               
    logout    Clear stored OAuth tokens                                                                        
    status    Show current authentication status                                                               
    config    Manage configuration                                                                             
   profile    Manage gscdump profiles (per-account token + config dirs)                                        
    doctor    Run health checks (env, auth, scopes, time, dataDir, store, GSC reachability + ping, defaultSite)
       mcp    Start MCP server for AI assistants                                                               
     skill    Install the packaged coding agent skill                                                          
  papercut    Report a CLI problem to gscdump.com (anonymous, sanitized)                                       

Use gscdump <command> --help for more information about a command.

No command specified.
